appDescription: CHABAK helps travelers find registered campsites for vehicle-based stays.

function.name: SEARCH_CAMPING_PLACE
function.description: Searches registered campsites in a selected region and displays matching places in CHABAK.

region.description: The broad region to search for campsites.

district.description: The optional city or district within the selected region.

nature.description: The optional registered natural setting of the campsite.

electric.description: Whether registered electricity facilities are required.

store.description: Whether a registered shop or convenience store is required.
